body:
### Context
Build a 12-month seasonality visualization displaying dividend events and buy window distribution across the year, alongside a watchlist export component (CSV download and 1-click clipboard copy).

### Phase
Phase 3: Screener UI & User Experience

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `components/SeasonalityChart.tsx` renders 12-month timeline / heatmap of upcoming dividend accumulation windows.
- [ ] `components/WatchlistExport.tsx` provides:
  - Download filtered screener results as `.csv` file.
  - 1-click "Copy Tickers to Clipboard" (e.g. `ASII,BBCA,BBRI,PTBA`) with confirmation toast.
- [ ] Export actions only include currently filtered opportunities.

### Verification
CSV download produces valid formatted file and clipboard copy yields comma-separated ticker string.

### Blockers
Blocked by #12
title: Task 11: Seasonality Timeline & Watchlist Exporter

body:
### Context
Build responsive filter bar controls and high-level KPI stat summary cards to filter and analyze radar opportunities.

### Phase
Phase 3: Screener UI & User Experience

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `components/FilterBar.tsx` controls:
  - Minimum Yield % slider / input (0%–25%).
  - Accumulation Month selector (Jan–Dec or "All").
  - Window status filter tabs (All, In Window, Approaching).
  - Search input with debounced ticker / company filtering.
  - Reset filters button.
- [ ] `components/StatsOverview.tsx` KPI cards:
  - Active Buy Windows count.
  - Approaching Windows count.
  - Average estimated yield.
  - Next upcoming Cum Date.

### Verification
Adjusting filters immediately recalculates KPI stats and visible list.

### Blockers
Blocked by #10
title: Task 9: Multi-Parameter Filter Bar & Summary Stats
